scope: The Windsor Hotel exterior circa 1912, with the original Second Empire hotel at Peel and Dorchester, the adjoining 1906–09 north annex at Cypress, and the two open service courts shown in the Goad atlas. Interior rooms and contemporary neighboring buildings are outside the reconstruction.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Quebec register identifies the surviving Windsor north annex, construction beginning in 1906, at 1160 and 1170 Peel Street.
The city distinguishes the original hotel lost following the 1957 fire from the surviving 1906–09 annex.
Photograph catalogued with both hotel wings and explicitly released as public domain.
Public-domain 1912 Goad plate 14 supplies the historic building perimeter and two open service courts.
